verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of employer-of-record services or global/international payroll offerings; Gusto's embedded payroll docs and product overview focus entirely on US company onboarding, tax filing, and contractor payments. Community evidence directly contradicts any international capability: one HN commenter explicitly states 'Gusto doesn't support outside of US folks' and another notes they had to switch providers because employees spread across multiple states/countries couldn't be accommodated.
